metadata.title: The Chemical Composition of Extreme-Velocity Stars

notes: No eligible stars. The paper repeatedly calls its targets hypervelocity/HVS candidates, but it explicitly defines HVSs there as extreme-velocity stars “but not necessarily unbound” (T:p2-b2) and concludes that the sample stars “are bound to the Galactic potential” (T:p13-b3). The sample was selected from “extreme-velocity stars” with total velocities ≳300 km s⁻¹ (T:p2-b9), not from an explicit prior Galactic-unbound candidacy. Positive E_tot values appear in Table 3, but the paper does not present them as an unbound criterion and its explicit final assessment is that the targets are bound.
